integrity: Theorem, explicit witness, Palm formula and checker code are embedded as complete files; no external data or omitted supporting computations are required for the finite diagnostics.
scientific_limitations: The Palm integrals are not evaluated as scalar constants; sharp critical-aperture asymptotics are open here. Full historical priority, especially older cone-nearest-neighbor cycle theory, remains uncertain. Finite diagnostics do not prove asymptotic probability statements.
title: Reentrant pancyclicity and positive cycle densities in reflex directional nearest-neighbour graphs
